An app icon, and months that start on the day you choose.

- **App icon**: a message bubble with a rising bar chart, in the app's colors. On Android 13 and later it also follows your themed icons.
- **Month starts on**: in Settings → Month, pick the day your month starts, for example 22 for a month that runs from the 22nd to the 21st of the next month. Home, Activity ("This month", "Last month", quarters) and Insights (this month and the monthly trend) all follow it. A month is named after the calendar month most of its days fall in, and Home and Insights show its dates, for example "December 2026 · 22 Nov – 21 Dec".

APK: arm64-v8a, built and signed by GitHub Actions.
